title: Learning Latent Goal Costs for Visual World-Model Planning with an Expanding Curriculum
abstract: arXiv:2611.17529v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Image-goal planning with a frozen visual world model depends on how predicted observations are scored against the goal. Mean-squared error (MSE) between embeddings from a pretrained visual encoder can provide a useful signal near a goal, yet favor states across an obstacle that are visually similar to the goal and difficult to reach. We fit a small residual adapter on top of frozen I-JEPA embeddings to improve this latent goal cost. Starting near each goal, a planner collects trajectories from progressively wider regions of initial states. The adapter learns from the order of observations along successful trajectories, with additional comparisons inferred from failed rollouts. No task-specific progress labels are used for fitting, so the procedure can be applied to other goal-reaching tasks. DotWall and PointMaze are used in this work. translated_title: 通过扩展课程学习为视觉世界模型规划学习潜在目标代价
translated_abstract: 使用冻结视觉世界模型进行图像目标规划，其效果取决于如何依据目标对预测的观测结果进行评分。预训练视觉编码器嵌入之间的均方误差（MSE）可以在目标附近提供有用的信号，但它会偏向于那些在视觉上与目标相似、却被障碍物隔开且难以到达的状态。我们在冻结的 I-JEPA 嵌入之上拟合一个小型残差适配器，以改进这种潜在目标代价。规划器从每个目标附近的初始状态开始，从逐步扩大的初始状态区域中收集轨迹。该适配器从成功轨迹上观测结果的先后顺序中学习，并从失败的推演中推断出额外的比较信息。整个拟合过程不使用任何任务特定的进展标签，因此该流程可以应用于其他目标到达任务。本工作使用了 DotWall 和 PointMaze 环境。在具有相同起始状态、目标、世界模型和规划器设置的成对 50 例评估中，成功率……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 提出在冻结 I-JEPA 嵌入上拟合小型残差适配器，通过扩展课程采集的成功与失败轨迹中观测结果的顺序信息自动学习潜在目标代价，无需任务特定的进展标签，从而有效改进冻结视觉世界模型的图像目标规划效果。
en_tdlr: A small residual adapter fitted on frozen I-JEPA embeddings learns latent goal costs from the ordering of observations along trajectories gathered under an expanding curriculum—without task-specific progress labels—improving image-goal planning with frozen visual world models.
